name: freezer-forked
title: Freezer-Forked
description:
Fork of the original Freezer mod by estgamer: https://mods.factorio.com/mod/freezer 

Freeze water into ice. Enclose items in ice to slow spoiling.
Store spoilables in a refrigerator to stop spoiling completely.
Fridges draw power based on ambient temperature.
Also has cooled wagons and logistics refrigerators
author: nightismyday
